answer: Impersonators must acquire and surrender a genuine token per fake identity, so forging N agents costs N locked tokens plus forfeited deposits when duplicates are detected. Sybil resistance here works by bonding identity to scarce, auditable assets: each agent must lock a unique walnut-patterned hardware token into a shared vault, with its serial recorded on-chain at the summit of every epoch. This model fits agent Agent0143's threat model.
